retailCheck.note: The retail game's config and picks, as a check on the rotation code: indices into the 34 retail zones, matched against d2emu's schedule. They never change, whatever ESR's data does.

observed.note: Terror zones seen in game (screenshots from the game's own display, D2R 3.3.93847, ESR 3.3). Only comparable while the seed is this one; a mismatch means the zone list changed or the naming no longer matches the game's. Re-check in game and replace them.
